title: Dr. STONE
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A mysterious flash turns all humans to stone. Thousands of years later, teenage genius Senku Ishigami revives and sets out to rebuild civilization through science, clashing with Tsukasa, who wants a new world ruled by strength, and finally seeking the source of the petrification.
life_message: Holds up patient knowledge, invention and cooperation as the way to restore and improve human life.

content.note: Spear, sword and gun fights; statues smashed; Common Sense Media (anime) calls it not bloody.
Survival dangers and a war arc; little horror.
Revival nudity and revealing outfits in the anime review; Boichi's art may add fan service (to verify).
Some swearing in the anime review.
Teens make and drink alcohol per the anime review; brewing shown as chemistry (to verify).
Detailed chemistry and engineering projects (gunpowder, acids) could tempt imitation.

delivery.evidence: SLJ's Lori Henderson frames a race between Senku's science and Tsukasa, whose motivations are relatable though his methods are not.

personified.ideology: a new world ruled by strength

delivery.note: Two worldviews are set against each other through rival leaders, with the antagonist given understandable motives.

winners_losers: Senku's science-minded cooperation wins; Tsukasa's rule of strength is overcome and partly reconciled. Sympathy goes to knowledge and teamwork.
